The mirror rot is recurring, not one-off. No workflow executed any of the test modules this repair adds or repairs. .github/workflows/ invokes tests in only two places, drift-immunity-guard.yml (continuous_obs_runtime and executor_broker) and real-same-identity-ubjson.yml (six named canonical.tests modules), so test_live_repository_is_reconciled, the standing oracle for the mirror rot this PR's own blocker names, never ran in CI, and neither did either Stage-A reducer suite. Cut membership is adjudicated by reusing the bindings canonical/runtime/current_state_obs_reducer.py already enforces (status ACTIVE, law path, exact_cut_runtime path, scheduling authority with family_labels and benchmark_rank_order both false, and the three untouched_information_spend rules) plus the cut's own snapshot.terminal_predicates and an explicit per-sample entry, rather than by defining a second notion of currency. Membership is deliberately not a cleanliness predicate: rank23's adjudication records prior_stage_a_cleanliness_preserved true together with global_cut_admission_before_source_read false, and the cut records that sample as INDEPENDENT_PASS__CLEANNESS_ONLY, so established cleanliness survives while membership separately gates authorization, which is the only thing it ever gated. The item is expected exactly when the live policy lists it, so a root whose policy predates the cut law still reproduces its recorded verdict field for field.
conclusion: Repair the predicates and the comparison rules, never the evidence, and let the recorded artifacts arbitrate. Replace the blanket dict-wide zero test with named checks over the eight canonical hit counters plus explicit completeness predicates; mirror v1's hit classification exactly; compare every shared key of the two reducers' verdicts, including the rule label; port the two predicates v2 was missing so absence of evidence refuses rather than raises; match the lease status on its semantic prefix so it cannot rot per rank; replace the guard's frozen version constants with a currency rule and make it name the repair for what it reports; reconcile all eleven mirror fields plus the authority's own stale progress-event mirror with a tested tool that fails closed on anything it cannot repair; and discover the oracles from the tree instead of pinning them to a rank, because the frontier moves faster than a hardcoded oracle survives. No frontier is redefined and no evidence is spent or rewritten.
